meta.also: Ad and video specs from the 2026-11-17 creative batch (render_static.py, render_video.py).

themes.name: Dark: ad panels, video, dark bands

tokens.name: portal-charcoal
tokens.usage: Body text on white and cream. Ground of the static-ad text panel and the video end card.

tokens.name: portal-dark
tokens.usage: Headings on white and cream. Ground of dark bands. Base color of the photo scrim.

tokens.name: portal-gray
tokens.usage: Nav links and review text on white (8.9:1). Hairlines on dark grounds.

tokens.name: portal-mid
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white (5.3:1) and on cream (4.8:1).

tokens.name: portal-light
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on white. Sub line and proof line on charcoal (11.0:1).

tokens.name: portal-cream
tokens.usage: Alternate section band, area chips and FAQ cards on the website.

tokens.name: portal-warm
tokens.usage: Muted text and the URL line on charcoal (8.9:1) and portal-dark.

tokens.name: portal-accent
tokens.usage: The Portal green. Fill behind white text (5.1:1): buttons, the Free estimate badge, the AFTER tag. Green text on white (5.1:1) and cream (4.6:1). Too dark for text on charcoal (2.7:1): use portal-accent-light there.

tokens.name: portal-accent-dark
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of green fills and green links.

tokens.name: portal-white
tokens.usage: Added. Page ground on the web, and text and logo on charcoal, portal-dark and the scrim.

tokens.name: portal-accent-light
tokens.usage: Added. Green text and icons on charcoal (6.1:1) and portal-dark (7.7:1), where portal-accent is too dark to read. Never a fill behind white text.

tokens.name: portal-star
tokens.usage: Star ratings only, as on the website. Never text and never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: portal-scrim
tokens.usage: Added as a token. The box behind captions and BEFORE tags laid on photos. The 2026-11-17 batch used 0.82 to 0.86; 0.85 is the standard from here on. White text on it passes on any photo.

tokens.name: portal-error
tokens.usage: Form error text only, as on the contact form (4.8:1 on white). Pair it with words that say what went wrong.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page or frame ground.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate band on the web. In dark, the static-ad text panel and the video end card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body copy and ad sub lines on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Nav links, review text and area chip labels on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, the trust bar and the URL line on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between bands and under the header. Decorative only (1.3:1 on white; 2.0:1 on portal-dark and 1.6:1 on charcoal in dark): never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-outline
tokens.usage: Border of the secondary button, as on the website. Below 3:1 in the source, so the button label must carry it.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of primary buttons, the Free estimate badge and the AFTER tag. Always with on-accent text.

tokens.name: accent-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent-fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill (5.1:1) and accent-fill-pressed (7.4:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Green text, links, icons and the focus ring on surface and surface-alt.

styles.name: web-h1
styles.usage: Page title. 36px under 640px wide. Color ink.

styles.name: web-h2
styles.usage: Section heading. 30px with 36px leading under 640px wide. Color ink.

styles.name: web-h3
styles.usage: Card and tile titles. Color ink, or white on a photo.

styles.name: web-lead
styles.sample: Residential and commercial concrete projects of all sizes.
styles.usage: The one paragraph under a section heading. Color ink-muted.

styles.name: web-body
styles.sample: You'll know when we're showing up, what we're doing, and when we'll be done.
styles.usage: Running text. Color ink-body or ink-muted.

styles.name: web-quote
styles.sample: Consistent quality and a crew that actually cares about doing things right.
styles.usage: Customer quotes, always italic. In a PullQuote the author is upright in accent-ink; in a ReviewCard the author is ink.

styles.name: web-button
styles.usage: Large buttons in the hero and on landing pages.

styles.name: web-label
styles.usage: Header button, nav links (500), chips (500), the trust bar (500) and review authors.

styles.name: ad-headline
styles.usage: One headline per ad, white on the charcoal panel. 58px on 960x1200, 42px on 1200x628.

styles.name: ad-sub
styles.sample: We replace them with new concrete.
styles.usage: The one supporting line, portal-light. 30px on 960x1200, 24px on 1200x628.

styles.name: ad-proof
styles.usage: The rating line above the badge, portal-light. 25px and 21px on the other sizes.

styles.name: ad-cta
styles.usage: Text of the CtaBadge. 30px and 23px on the other sizes.

styles.name: ad-tag
styles.usage: BEFORE and AFTER photo tags, the only all-caps text in the system. 24px and 20px on the other sizes.

styles.name: video-caption
styles.usage: Scene caption, white in a portal-scrim box, two lines at most.

styles.name: video-tag
styles.usage: BEFORE and AFTER tags in video.

styles.name: video-endcard-head
styles.usage: End card headline, white on charcoal.

styles.name: video-endcard-line
styles.usage: Proof lines on the end card, portal-light.

styles.name: video-cta
styles.usage: Text of the end card CtaBadge.

styles.name: video-url
styles.usage: The URL on the end card, portal-warm. Video only: static ads leave the URL off.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between rating stars.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label in buttons, links and the trust bar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between before and after photos on the web, and between stars and the rating text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter under 640px. Gap between paired buttons.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a service tile's text.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter from 640px. Gap in card grids.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Review card padding. Gap between before/after pairs.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Column gap in three-up rows. Space above a section's closing link.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Space between a section heading block and its grid.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding, top and bottom, under 640px.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Section padding, top and bottom, from 640px.

tokens.name: ad-panel-pad
tokens.usage: Inner padding of the static-ad text panel at 1200x1200. 40px at 960x1200, 34px at 1200x628.

tokens.name: video-safe-top
tokens.usage: Keep text below this line in 1080x1920 video. Meta's Reels ad guide reserves the top 269px; Portal rounds to 270px.

tokens.name: video-safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Keep text above this distance from the bottom: Meta reserves the bottom 35% for the CTA button and caption.

tokens.name: video-safe-left
tokens.usage: Left text margin in video. Meta asks for at least 65px; Portal uses 70px.

tokens.name: video-safe-right
tokens.usage: Right text margin in video. Portal's own choice, wider than Meta's 65px, to stay clear of the like and share buttons on Reels and Shorts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: BEFORE and AFTER tags on static ads.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, the header CTA and menu items on the website.

tokens.name: radius-tag-video
tokens.usage: BEFORE and AFTER tags in video.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Photos, review cards, FAQ cards and service tiles.

tokens.name: radius-caption
tokens.usage: Caption boxes in video.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The Free estimate badge in ads and video, and area chips.

duration.note: Motion is slow and plain. Everything stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Website sections fade in and rise 24px once, easing cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).

tokens.name: duration-spiral
tokens.usage: One full turn of the spiral watermark behind the hero logo. Linear, endless.

tokens.name: duration-transition
tokens.usage: Crossfade or left wipe between video scenes.

tokens.name: duration-caption-fade
tokens.usage: Video caption fade-in, starting 0.25s into its scene.

tokens.name: opacity-watermark
tokens.usage: The spiral watermark behind the hero logo.
